tasks.plan:
## Overview

Build video generation feature for Diamond social platform. Connect HeyGen Creator ($29/month) for automated video creation. Campaign operators can enable/disable video generation per campaign, with per-post overrides. Videos are generated via HeyGen API, stored in Firestore, with error handling for interactive posts (UI feedback) and automated posts (email notifications).

## Design Summary

**User Problem**: Campaign operators need to automatically generate video assets instead of creating them manually. Videos are essential for social engagement (TikTok requires 15-second videos daily; YouTube uses 60-second videos twice monthly).

**Service Selection**: HeyGen Creator ($29/month, 600 credits/month) provides quality video generation at $0.97/video estimated cost.

**Platform Requirements**:
- TikTok: REQUIRES videos
- YouTube: PRIORITIZES videos
- X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, Reddit: OPTIONAL

## Implementation Phases

1. **Video Generation Service Selection & Research** â€” Document HeyGen API, authentication, credit system, rate limits
2. **Firestore Schema & Configuration** â€” Extend campaign/post documents with video settings; define platform specs
3. **Campaign UI â€” Video Generation Toggle** â€” Add toggle to campaign settings with platform-specific format configuration
4. **Post UI â€” Per-Post Video Generation Toggle** â€” Add per-post toggle with override logic
5. **Video Generation Module & Integration** â€” Create worker module, wire HeyGen API, integrate into post flow
6. **Error Handling & Notifications** â€” Surface errors in interactive posts; email notifications for automated failures
7. **Manual Validation & Testing** â€” End-to-end testing with human review of video quality

## Key Assumptions

- HeyGen API availability and response quality
- Manual validation phase catches unusable outputs before scaling
- Credit usage ~15-20 per 15-second video, 20-30 per 60-second video
- Platform-specific format/size specs are configurable
- Email notification service available for automated post failures

## Estimated Effort

5 Small + 8 Medium + 2 Large â‰ˆ 6-8 days solo

## Success Criteria

- Campaign operators can enable/disable video generation per campaign
- Per-post toggle overrides campaign default
- Videos generated via HeyGen API and stored in Firestore
- Interactive post errors show in UI; automated failures trigger email
- Manual validation confirms video quality meets campaign standards
- Daily TikTok (15-sec) and twice-monthly YouTube (60-sec) within Creator plan limits

proofUnits.title: HeyGen Configuration Documented
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Documentation clearly explains HeyGen API authentication, credit system, rate limits, and video generation request/response workflow.
proofUnits.exactCommand: Read docs/video-generation-approach.md; verify sections: API auth (key location, headers), Credit system (costs per video length), Rate limits, Request shape (prompt, duration, platform specs), Response shape (video URL, job status), Polling strategy
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: File exists with complete sections on HeyGen API design and integration approach. Example cURL request succeeds.
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: N/A â€” documentation is manually verified.

proofUnits.title: Campaign Schema Extended with Video Settings
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Campaign documents in Firestore now have videoGenerationEnabled, videoGenerationPlatforms, and videoQualitySize fields; constants define schema shape.
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Constants do not include video generation fields; Firestore schema does not enforce them.
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Diff shows new constants: CAMPAIGN_VIDEO_GENERATION_FIELDS, VIDEO_SPECS_BY_PLATFORM with platform keys.
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: If Firestore rules not enforced, manual verification: create test campaign in Firestore UI, confirm fields present.

proofUnits.title: Post Schema Extended with Video References
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Post documents now have videoGenerationRequested, generatedVideoUrl, generatedVideoPrompt, and videoGenerationStatus fields.
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Constants do not include video fields on post schema.
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Diff shows new post video fields in constants. Sample post document created with fields present.
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: Manual: open Firebase Console, create test post, verify fields appear.

proofUnits.title: Campaign UI Renders Video Generation Controls
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Campaign settings page shows video generation toggle (on/off) and platform-specific format dropdowns (TikTok, YouTube, etc.).
proofUnits.exactCommand: Launch Diamond app (npm start); navigate to campaign settings; look for video generation toggle switch and platform video specs dropdown; inspect element for data-testid='video-toggle' and data-testid='platform-video-size'
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Campaign settings page has no video controls; elements don't exist.
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Toggle switch visible and clickable; format dropdown selects platform-specific sizes (e.g., 'TikTok 9:16 1080p', 'YouTube 16:9 1080p').
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: N/A â€” UI is manually verified in browser.

proofUnits.title: Campaign Video Settings Persist to Firestore
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Toggling video generation on/off in campaign settings saves to Firestore under campaign document; reload confirms persistence.
proofUnits.exactCommand: Launch Diamond, open campaign settings; toggle video generation ON; click Save; in Firebase Console, navigate to campaign document; confirm videoGenerationEnabled = true; close and reopen campaign settings in Diamond; confirm toggle still ON
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Toggle has no effect; Firestore document unchanged.
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Firestore document updated after Save; toggle state persists across app reload.
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: N/A â€” manual verification with Firebase Console.

proofUnits.title: Post UI Shows Video Toggle with Campaign Default
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Post creation page shows video generation toggle. When campaign has video enabled, toggle starts checked. Per-post changes override campaign setting.
proofUnits.exactCommand: Launch Diamond, select campaign with video generation enabled; create new post; inspect element for data-testid='post-video-toggle'; confirm toggle is checked (campaign default); uncheck toggle (per-post override); save post, reload; confirm toggle remains unchecked (per-post override persisted)
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Post page has no video toggle.
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Toggle exists, respects campaign default on first view, per-post override persists across reload.
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: N/A â€” UI verified in browser.

proofUnits.title: Video Generation Worker Makes HeyGen API Calls
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: src/video-generation-worker.js successfully calls HeyGen API with authenticated request, receives video URL in response, stores URL in Firestore post document.
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: File does not exist; test fails 'module not found'.
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Test file exists with passing tests: authenticateHeyGenRequest() constructs Authorization header, generateVideo() POSTs to HeyGen endpoint and polls for completion, storeVideoUrl() writes URL to Firestore post document
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: If HeyGen API cannot be mocked reliably, use manual smoke test: generate one video, confirm URL in Firestore.

proofUnits.title: Video Generation Integrated into Post Creation Flow
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: When post is created with videoGenerationRequested = true, video generation worker is called; post document receives generatedVideoUrl after completion.
proofUnits.exactCommand: Launch Diamond; create new post with video generation toggle enabled; save post; wait for video generation (monitor Firestore in real-time); after ~30 seconds, check post document for generatedVideoUrl field; confirm URL points to valid video file
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: Post saved but no video generation triggered; generatedVideoUrl remains empty.
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Post document populates generatedVideoUrl with HeyGen video link within reasonable timeout.
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: Manual verification with Firestore Console; no automated test due to async external service.

proofUnits.title: Video Generation Errors Surface in Interactive Posts
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: When video generation fails for an interactive (non-automated) post, error message displays in UI allowing user to adjust prompt and retry.
proofUnits.exactCommand: Intentionally trigger generation failure (use invalid HeyGen key or mock API error); create post with video toggle enabled; save post; confirm error message appears in UI: 'Video generation failed: {reason}'; confirm retry button present
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: No error feedback; post fails silently or crashes.
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Error message displays, retry button works, user can edit prompt and retry generation.
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: N/A â€” UI error handling verified manually.

proofUnits.title: Automated Post Failure Triggers Email Notification
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: When automated post fails due to video generation error, email notification sent to operator with campaign name, post details, and remediation steps. Post document marked with videoGenerationStatus = 'failed'.
proofUnits.exactCommand: Set up test automated post with video generation enabled; trigger video generation failure (mock API error); simulate automated posting; confirm email received in operator inbox with subject 'Diamond: Video generation failed for [campaign]'; confirm Firestore post document has videoGenerationStatus = 'failed'
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: No email sent; post status unchanged on failure.
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Email notification received; post document marks failure; no publish attempt occurs.
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: If email service not configured, document manual notification process (Slack, in-app alert) instead.

proofUnits.title: End-to-End Manual Validation Checklist Complete
proofUnits.expectedBehavior: Manual test plan executed across TikTok (15-second), YouTube (60-second), and other platforms. Video quality approved; error handling confirmed for both interactive and automated posts.
proofUnits.exactCommand: Run docs/video-generation-manual-test-plan.md: create test campaign with video enabled; generate TikTok 15-sec video, confirm quality; generate YouTube 60-sec video, confirm quality; test per-post override; trigger error on interactive post, confirm UI feedback and retry; trigger error on automated post (mocked), confirm email sent; verify credit usage aligns with estimates
proofUnits.expectedInitialFailure: No manual test plan exists; videos not yet generated.
proofUnits.expectedPassingEvidence: Test plan document completed with all checks passed. Video quality approved by operator. No critical errors.
proofUnits.waiverGuidance: Operator sign-off on quality is the gate. If quality unsatisfactory, document feedback and adjust prompts.
